summary: Frontend-only verification of new top-level Cohorts & Operations sidebar nav (manager-only) and corresponding /cohorts and /operations routes after iter7 follow-up. All 7 acceptance criteria from the review request passed cleanly. No regressions detected.
verified_acceptance_criteria: Manager sidebar shows ALL 9 nav items including new nav-cohorts (Layers icon, label 'Cohorts') and nav-operations (ClipboardList icon, label 'Operations') alongside nav-today, nav-customers, nav-inbox, nav-lookbooks, nav-manager, nav-templates, nav-audit. PASS.

Associate sidebar correctly hides nav-cohorts, nav-operations, nav-manager, nav-templates, nav-audit (manager-only flag respected). Only nav-today, nav-customers, nav-inbox, nav-lookbooks visible. PASS.

/cohorts as manager renders data-testid='cohorts-page', H1 text = 'Cohorts', and nested CohortsTab content (cohorts-tab + cohort-retention-table + tier-flow-chart + channel-cohort-table + cohort-triangle-btn all visible). PASS.
/cohorts as associate redirects to /dashboard (cohorts-page not rendered). PASS.

/operations as manager renders data-testid='operations-page', H1 = 'Operations', and OperationsTab cards (daily-brief-card, leaderboard-card, ltv-top-card, reorder-card, upcoming-events-card all visible). PASS.
/operations as associate redirects to /dashboard (operations-page not rendered). PASS.

Manager /manager nested tabs still work — manager-tab-cohorts and manager-tab-operations both visible & switchable. Switching to manager-tab-cohorts shows cohorts-tab; switching to manager-tab-operations shows daily-brief-card. TabsList className includes 'flex-wrap'. PASS.
Regression: /dashboard, /customers, /inbox, /lookbooks, /templates, /audit all load (HTTP 200, body length > 100KB, URLs unchanged). PASS.

test_evidence.tabs_list_classes: inline-flex items-center text-muted-foreground bg-transparent border-b border-[var(--vivo-border)] w-full justify-start rounded-none h-auto p-0 gap-6 flex-wrap

critical_code_review_comments: InsightsPages.jsx is a thin and clean page wrapper — good separation. No issues.
AppShell.jsx NAV array correctly uses manager:true flag and filter by isManager. Clean.
App.js uses inline ternaries for role-gated routes (consistent with /manager, /templates, /audit pattern). OK, but consider extracting a <ManagerRoute> wrapper if more manager-only routes are added.

Both top-level pages (/cohorts, /operations) and the nested /manager tabs render the same components — duplicated visual surface. Consider whether nested tabs should now deep-link to top-level routes to avoid duplicate entry points (UX consistency, minor).
